name: strongs-lexicount
description: A modern web application for analyzing biblical text with Strong's numbers
author: Patrick Rutledge

scripts.predist: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'dist-electron-store\appx-output') { Remove-Item 'dist-electron-store\appx-output' -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'dist-electron-store\appx-output\Assets'; Copy-Item 'store-assets\icons\*.png' 'dist-electron-store\appx-output\Assets\'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'dist-electron-store\appx-output\app'"
scripts.dist: npm run pack && powershell -Command "Copy-Item 'dist-electron-store\win-unpacked\*' 'dist-electron-store\appx-output\app\' -Recurse; Copy-Item 'dist-electron-store\__appx-x64\AppxManifest.xml' 'dist-electron-store\appx-output\'; & 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\bin\10.0.26100.0\x64\makeappx.exe' pack /d 'dist-electron-store\appx-output' /p 'dist-electron-store\Strong''s LexiCount 1.0.0.appx' /nv"
